set: E: the rail camera and the last save beside the approved images, whole and in crops

issues.where: the close-up framing, central rails and background on both sides
issues.what: The target looks straight down a continuous, centered chrome channel into a softly lit street. The build looks across the channel: its uprights and feet crowd the middle, a matte black divider and a flipper fill the left, and a warning triangle and bright disc pull the eye right.
issues.fix: Reorient the close camera along the local rail axis and let the lines converge toward the upper center. Keep the approved street layout and take position, but frame the foreground hardware out and let depth of field subordinate the remaining background.

issues.where: right crop, the firehouse
issues.what: The cell shows an orange flipper and dark divider instead of the red facade, red rooftop beacon and warm garage light.
issues.fix: Re-anchor this crop to the firehouse wherever the approved layout puts it. If it is out of the close camera's frame, use a corresponding close still with the building in view rather than presenting the flipper as the firehouse.

issues.where: upper half, overall depth and framing
issues.what: The rear reads as hard, exposed machinery against a dark back wall. The rail climbs diagonally out of the image, with dense support hardware and stark upright reflections, rather than reading as a low, soft chrome arc across a receding miniature street. The tall right metal structure is cut off and dominates that corner.
issues.fix: Adjust the camera aim and focus so the rail reads across the street, keep the tall spiral legible as a receding form, and let the distant supports, background casing and lights soften into depth without changing the configured part dimensions.

issues.where: middle-left crop, the card at the foot
issues.what: This crop lands on a different white face and the amber display, not on the centered framed plaque over the drain.
issues.fix: Center the crop on the gold-edged plaque over the central opening, retaining the shoulder display elsewhere as specified.

issues.where: the ball and cursor, lower center
issues.what: The glass has a nearly uniform bluish rim and crisp lines of the track visible straight through it. A square white highlight wipes out much of the cursor. The target has clear, curved refraction, clustered warm pinlights and a legible ivory face with a deep continuous dark bevel.
issues.fix: Add curved refraction and layered warm edge glints, suppress the square hotspot over the face, and make the cursor face softly lit with rounded transitions and a continuous beveled dark edge.

issues.where: rails and cross ties
issues.what: The primary rails and ties look gray and segmented, with broad flat runs and visible junctions rather than polished round metal with continuous hot highlights and warm reflected color.
issues.fix: Round and polish the profiles, smooth the joints, and carry fine bright and warm reflected streaks down the continuous tube surfaces.

issues.where: street floor, lamps and lit background
issues.what: Fine grid art, highly legible road markings and long straight white light streaks dominate the build's floor. The target has richer navy-teal lacquer, softly scattered amber pools, more irregular wear and a warmer blurred distance.
issues.fix: Quiet the construction grid, add restrained scuffs and uneven lacquer sheen, shorten and diffuse the lamp reflections, and let the far lamps gather into warm soft bokeh.

issues.where: left crop, cursor and sphere
issues.what: The cursor ends are sharper and flatter, the rim reads as a pale smoky shell, and hard rectangular glare crosses the cursor and obscures the notch and face. Straight lines and uniform bands inside the glass replace the target's curved, broken highlights.
issues.fix: Round the arrow's shoulder, notch, and tip slightly, build a dark dimensional bevel visible around its pale face, and replace the shell haze and panel glare with curved refraction and smaller warm glints.

issues.where: foreground opening and its surrounding front panel
issues.what: A guardrail and broad light fascia interrupt the run into the center drain; the hole barely reads below its label. The target shows a distinct recessed black throat between lateral off-white panels, with exposed metal jambs and the framed plaque capping the opening.
issues.fix: Reveal the throat and metal transition in the camera framing, visually open the center approach, and give the surrounding off-white surfaces gently rounded edges and mottled satin material, rather than a largely flat machine fascia.

issues.where: pair of orange flippers and yellow slingshots
issues.what: The flippers are flat mustard-orange with dull gray hardware, raised-looking dark layers, and conspicuous square-section guides beside them. The slingshots look like shiny dark-orange plates perched on exposed legs over dark circular pools rather than warm yellow enamel capping rounded reflective bodies.
issues.fix: Use warmer candy-orange lacquer with a tight edge highlight, a distinct smooth black rubber band, and polished inset fasteners. Turn the slingshot faces toward yellow satin enamel, give them a round chrome shoulder and a reflective lower body, and tighten their contact shadows.

issues.where: left foreground, the small house and its adjacent pocket
issues.what: The house reads as a bright porch model behind a heavy rail, with a broad circular black bowl on its outside. The target has a compact, shadowed entry and a separate clean rectangular metal-rimmed well alongside it; the sign is a noticeably different black, heavy sans-serif treatment.
issues.fix: Give the well a radiused rectangular rim and genuinely dark inner wall, bring the house entry and window lighting forward, and use a calmer dark serif treatment on a warm paper sign, preserving its specified roof placement and tilt.

issues.where: floor surface, center road, marker lamps and far lights
issues.what: The surface reads like fine blue grit over grid-printed road art. The red, white and amber inserts look like intense stepped concentric buttons, and several background lights send rigid white streaks toward camera. The target reads as worn, deep teal lacquer with lower-key insets and softer, shorter reflections.
issues.fix: Lower the grid contrast and noise, introduce fine directional scuffs and warmer local reflection, and bring the diffused lamp faces into visually simpler metal seats rather than stacking bright rings.

issues.where: top-left crop, ball over the flipper and neighboring lamps
issues.what: The cooler ball rim and window-shaped highlight make the sphere look like a translucent shell with a reflection pasted on. The cursor's dark offset edge nearly disappears against the sharp glints. The lamp bezels and lit faces behind it compete with the focal object.
issues.fix: Make the sphere clearer with a curved warm rim and small separated glints, keep a readable white face with a dark beveled edge, and soften and simplify the lamp rims and emitted highlights behind it.

issues.where: top-middle crop, flipper
issues.what: The plastic has an almost even brown-orange fill, two dull disks and a visible seam across the top, above a matte dark strip and a distracting square-section striker guide. The target has bright satin orange highlights, a rounded clear-coated shoulder, a polished pivot and a distinct simple rubber band.
issues.fix: Give the cap a rounded lacquer highlight, subordinate the top seam and secondary disk, recess and polish the visible hardware, and reduce the visual weight of the straight guide and extra edge layers.

issues.where: top-right crop, slingshot
issues.what: The high-contrast black marks run almost edge-to-edge across a dark orange reflective plate, and separate posts and hard dark ovals are visible below. The target uses smaller stepped marks with yellow breathing room on a raised chrome-bodied unit lit from the side.
issues.fix: Keep the graphic direction but open yellow space around the marks, knock back face glare, connect the understructure visually with rounded reflective cladding, and replace the dark foot discs with tighter soft contact shadows.

issues.where: middle-center crop, house, sign and pocket
issues.what: The sign uses a heavy slanted sans-serif on a fairly flat yellow panel, the front is a pale bright porch rather than a darker wall with picked-out lit windows, and the pocket reads as a broad circular bowl on the opposite side of the crop.
issues.fix: Use fine dark serif lettering and a warmer paper face with a narrow frame; deepen the siding and window shadows; make the visible pocket read as a deep radiused rectangular recess with a polished rim rather than a round bowl.

issues.where: middle-right crop, firehouse
issues.what: The red beacon looks like an evenly luminous ribbed cap with almost no local bloom; behind and below it the facade, mullions, and shutter-like garage edge stay comparatively crisp, and the area is broken up by a bright red cylinder. The target is a soft red hotspot above a muted red facade, soft warm windows, and a dark recessed entry.
issues.fix: Give the beacon a hot small core with red spill over the roof, soften the facade with focus falloff, put warm spill inside the entry, and de-emphasize the foreground cylinder so the building reads as one shape.

issues.where: bottom-left crop, plaque and drain
issues.what: A guardrail cuts across the approach, the opening is low and mostly hidden, and the label is a heavier sans serif on a flat plate. The target's thin serif nameplate directly crowns a deep black channel with sloped metal cheeks and inset screws.
issues.fix: Show the recess and its side returns clearly directly below the plaque, open up its silhouette above, and use fine dark serif letters, a warm paper face, and a slim stepped gold border.

issues.where: bottom-middle crop, slab at the foot
issues.what: The slab is flat light gray with a straight embossed stripe, hard edge and regular pebbled finish, against brightly lit miniature lots. The target is softly rounded, off-white and irregularly mottled with very subtle wear.
issues.fix: Remove or soften the straight decorative ridge, round the visible edge and break the uniform gray with fine low-contrast paper-like clouding and wear.

issues.where: bottom-right crop, red lamp in the floor
issues.what: Several dark and red concentric rims make the lamp read as a raised assembly, and the surrounding rough blue print, road grid and hard shadow line are conspicuous. The target has a single slim bezel, a warmly diffused red center, and a comparatively uninterrupted glossy blue surface.
issues.fix: Seat a softly diffused red lens in one fine warm-metal ring, soften the hard perimeter, and let finer scuffs and quieter markings sit beneath a low satin reflection.
